rule: The GitHub master banner is immutable and is the 100% layout/composition reference. Runtime DEFAULT colors are read from the canonical Skin_053 theme; do not recolor or modify the master banner.

exactAspect4K.note: Preserves the master banner aspect ratio without cropping or distortion.

uhdCanvas.note: Do not stretch the 5:2 master layout to 16:9. Preserve the complete composition.

restrictions: Do not invent a second layout, skin, GUI shell or competing visual identity.
Keep the banner's overall left brand stage / right instrument-console composition and relative geometry as the master layout reference.
All runtime colors must use Skin_053 palette tokens.
No cyan, blue, teal or turquoise in NEON STAGE DEFAULT runtime assets.
Every interactive asset must map to a verified native component/APVTS binding in neon_stage_control_map.json.
Decorative assets must be explicitly marked decorative and must not imply interaction.
SVG is the vector source of truth; raster exports are generated derivatives only.
